titulo_es: To point out uncertainty shared by two studies

texto: Attribute ideas and summarize coincidences and discrepancies between sources. **Båda studierna pekar på osäkerhet** means «Both studies point to uncertainty». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
